reason: In GitHubInstallation.dispatch, the `except Integration.DoesNotExist: return pipeline.next_step()` branch (integration.py ~479-481) skips the installer check, which only runs later at ~493-503. build_integration (integration.py:351-353) then fetches `/app/installations/{installation_id}` with the app client for whatever id the user supplied, without checking who installed it.
